# Diagnosis of Lantern Incident

## 1. Root Cause Analysis

The reported incident—**"completed render occasionally returns to running"** and **"second retry creates a second render"**—stems from a fundamental violation of the **atomicity invariant** and the **idempotency invariant** in the current implementation.
